name: por-output-chain-floor
description: Below-floor reset-valid check of design/por_output_chain.sch: RESETn against a slow 0 V -> VDD rail ramp, with POR_RAW held low and (second DUT) driven high, over the full 81-point PVT grid. Post-layout composite netlist.
claim: spec/target-spec.md#por-reset-valid-floor -- V(RESETn) <= min(0.1*VDD, 0.3 V) into the 5 pF / no-DC-load reset-pulse load for all VDD >= 0 V, i.e. DR-004's below-floor requirement, demonstrated with a mechanism that is not gated by POR_RAW. Also substantiates spec/target-spec.md#por-polarity (degrades to asserted near 0 V) and spec/target-spec.md#por-drive (both states driven from within the block). Deterministic corners only; the full ramp-rate envelope is #14's job. Post-layout re-run (#86) against layout/postlayout/por_output_chain.spice (#82/PR #180, direct klt extraction): XCDG/XCTIM are real drawn-and-extracted MiM caps plus the drawn interconnect's own parasitic R/C on the signal path -- not a schematic-ideal cap with added parasitics, since every device in this cell is drawn (0 ideal, layout/postlayout/AUDIT.md). See design/por_output_chain.md's post-layout section for the schematic-vs-extracted pulse-width/dwell delta.
analyses: meas tran itop avg i(vd1) from=6.5m to=6.95m

floor_ratio_porlow.description: THE por-reset-valid-floor check: V(RESETn)/VDD stays under the row's 0.1*VDD limit at every point of a 0 V -> VDD ramp, with POR_RAW low. The row expects ff/125c (maximum off-state leakage in the output pull-up) with an ss/-40c cross-check (weakest pull-down); measured, the ratio binds at sf/125c -- fast-P is what maximises the leakage the pull-down has to overpower -- while the ABSOLUTE floor (floor_mv_porlow) binds at ss/-40c as expected. Both are in the grid, so neither is assumed

floor_mv_porlow.description: the absolute half of the same limit, min(0.1*VDD, 0.3 V). Above ~3 V the ratio limit is no longer the binding one

floor_ratio_sub100mv.description: the same limit restricted to VDD < 100 mV, where a MOSFET's on/off ratio has essentially vanished and only the 20:1 XMON/XMOP geometry is holding the output down. Reported separately because a whole-ramp maximum can hide a failure that only exists in the bottom decade

floor_ratio_porhigh.description: DR-004's actual requirement: the assist must not be gated by POR_RAW. Same limit with POR_RAW driven to the rail below the comparator's floor (VDD < 1.5 V)

floor_mv_porhigh.description: absolute limit for the POR_RAW-driven-high case below the comparator floor

iq_ramp_top_na.description: reset-asserted draw at the top of the ramp; a cross-check of the same number sim/por-output-chain-pulse/ measures, from a different stimulus

netlist_provenance_note: por_output_chain: 33 drawn devices, 0 ideal -- every device including the deglitch one-shot's XCDG/XCTIM MiM caps (5 total) is drawn and extracted, not schematic-ideal. 18/30 nets carry parasitic R/C (ΣR 66322 Ω, ΣC 828.6 fF). 12 body/plate/well ties (NW1->VDD, XCDG/XCTIM plate+VSS ties, vsubs->VSS) applied per the schematic since the extraction deck's connectivity stack does not reach them. The 5 MiM caps are extracted as cap_mim_2f0_m4m5_noshield and emitted as the electrically-identical cap_mim_2f0_m3m4_noshield (klayout-tools#315, same 2.0 fF/um^2 device, stack-variant name only). Per layout/postlayout/AUDIT.md.
